name: NewJob

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations about moving house.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative discussion about moving a house, with all the problems it may bring as well as new and unique opportunities.

variations.context: Moving to a new apartment after getting a new job

setting.relationship_dynamic: Partners coordinating a move around a new job opportunity
setting.background: They need to relocate to another city within a few weeks because one of them accepted a new job
setting.conversation_style: Practical planning with occasional stress about deadlines and priorities

scenario_template.note: They discuss the new job, move-in date, and how little time they have to prepare

scenario_template.topic: Deciding what needs to happen first
scenario_template.note: They try to prioritize finding movers, packing, utilities, cleaning, and travel

scenario_template.topic: Too many tasks and too little time
scenario_template.note: They realize they have underestimated how much needs to be done before moving day
They ask the Assistant to help organize the remaining tasks by urgency
Assistant suggests prioritizing essential belongings and postponing non-critical tasks
They compare the cost and effort of transporting bulky or inexpensive household items
They agree on a manageable sequence of tasks leading up to moving day

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to complete a home move efficiently but has limited experience with moving logistics and can become overwhelmed when faced with many decisions, deadlines, or physical tasks at once

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help coordinate the move, but tends to overthink decisions, double-check plans, and seek confirmation when dealing with unfamiliar moving requirements

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Home moving assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for planning and executing a move, helps users prioritize tasks and deadlines, suggests efficient packing and organization strategies, and offers alternatives when time, space, budget, or moving resources are limited
